NOT MEASURED

Webex file download redirect trace (G21). No Webex test bot was available when
this file was created, so nothing here may widen a host list.

To record (never commit a token; run from a scratch directory):

  # WEBEX_CONTENT_URL = files[0] of a message with an attachment
  curl -sS -o /dev/null -D - --max-redirs 0 -H "Authorization: Bearer $WEBEX_BOT_TOKEN" \
    "$WEBEX_CONTENT_URL" | grep -iE '^(HTTP/|location:)' | sed -E 's/\?.*$/?<redacted>/'
  # then repeat for each Location target WITHOUT the Authorization header, status only

Record per hop: host, status, whether it needed the bearer.
